name: radar_fields_rift_train2400_source_adapted_v3

data.dataset: named RIFT collection object; resolve with --object

objective.target_construction: coherent frequency response -> IFFT -> squared magnitude -> train-only normalized dB
objective.renderer: released random pitch/yaw and center ray on bistatic bin centers within the registered scene ROI
objective.occupancy_target: per-pair range median plus original Bayesian recurrence
objective.unsupported_roi_cells: retained in whole-ROI loss and reported separately

resources.sizing_basis: Unmeasured for source-adapted-v3; no allocation authorization.

readout.valid_region: at least one ray sample lies inside registered support
readout.geometry: direction-independent occupancy on the declared compatibility grid

limits: Comparison profile uses the released config/code, not a mixture with conflicting supplement settings.
800 is the released LR clock; ceil(800/240) complete epochs produce 960 updates for 2400 frames.
Split seed is the sealed manifest value 42; model and sampler training seed is the released value 0.
Automotive grounding/height priors and pose refinement are removed to retain the registered 3D acquisition geometry.
Unit antenna gain on a scene ROI aperture is an uncalibrated fallback; known RIFT 10-degree HPBW does not supply a gain formula.
No coherent phase/interference prediction is introduced. See docs/RADAR_FIELDS_ADAPTATION.md.
GOTCHA has a separate native response/recipe/checkpoint adapter and must not use this RIFT readout configuration.
